name.ja: <ruby>白<rt>はく</rt></ruby><ruby>鴉<rt>あ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>魔<rt>ま</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt>じょ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>幻姿<rt>まぼろし</rt></ruby>

text.en: Fusion Summon 1 Illusion Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your Extra Deck and/or field, also you cannot activate monster effects in the hand or GY for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, except Illusion monsters'. If the activation of this card in its owner's possession was negated by an opponent's card effect and sent to your GY: You can Set this card, and if you do, return all cards your opponent controls to the hand. You can only activate 1 "llusion of the Winter Raven Witch" per turn.
text.zh-CN: 此卡名的卡1回合仅可发动1张。①：将自己的额外牌组・场上的怪兽作为融合素材，将1只幻想魔族的融合怪兽融合召唤。此卡发动后，直至回合结束时为止自己不可发动幻想魔族以外的手牌・墓地的怪兽的效果。②：此卡的发动因对手被无效，且此卡被送至墓地的情况下可以发动。将此卡放置在自己场上，将对手场上的卡全部放回手牌。
